title: androsace chamaejasme subsp. lehmanniana
intro: Androsace chamaejasme subsp. lehmanniana, commonly known as Himalayan Rock Jasmine, is a flowering plant native to the Himalayas and other mountainous regions. The plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan Rock Jasmine include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
